name: Reborn guardians keep the stock guardians' area-of-effect avoidance
contract: Reborn class spells summon copies of the stock guardians at entry 1100000 + stock entry: 1151533 'Feral Spirit' summons two 1129264 (stock 51533 summons 29264) and 1170907 'Summon Water Elemental' summons 1100510 (stock 510) as a pet, so a second mage casts it rather than replacing the first mage's elemental. Guardian::InitStatsForLevel gives the stock Spirit Wolf and temporary Water Elemental 32233 'Pet Avoidance' (aura 310 -90% creature area damage, aura 229 -20%) together with their scaling auras. Live CoA combat logs (2026-05) show the reborn Spirit Wolf, Treant, Water Elemental, Fire Elemental and Shadowfiend taking about a tenth of the area damage players took from the same cast, and the 1134433 'Shadowfiend' tooltip says 'Damage taken by area of effect attacks is reduced.' Expected: every reborn copy wears 32233 like its stock guardian. Before the fix the guardian switch compared the raw entry, so the reborn copies wore no 32233.
